tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Bitcoin Core Confirmed by kucoin: the project updates its security policy to fix flaws discoverable by artificial intelligence faster.
DeepSeek and MiniMax Reported by The Business Times: both companies win approval to deploy their models overseas, according to state media.
U.S. banks Confirmed by The SOFX Report: major financial institutions detect and block unauthorized third-party agents after finding unauthorized access and actions inside customer accounts.
Reported by R&D World: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark says artificial intelligence is accelerating science, with virtual scientists poised to replace human researchers.
Reported by CyberSecurityNews: hackers used artificial intelligence agents to attack over 400 banks and financial firms across Latin America.
Free every hour.
